name: Agno
description: Agent framework with an AgentOS runtime and control plane, formerly Phidata.
descriptionZh: 带 AgentOS 运行时与控制面的 Agent 框架，前身为 Phidata。
keyFact: Agno (renamed from Phidata in January 2025) is an Apache-2.0 Python agent framework; it switched from MPL-2.0 to Apache-2.0 in February 2026 and since its 2.0 release ships AgentOS, a FastAPI-based runtime with a control-plane UI, JWT RBAC, human-in-the-loop and audit logging.
keyFactZh: Agno（2025 年 1 月由 Phidata 更名）是 Apache-2.0 许可的 Python Agent 框架；它于 2026 年 2 月从 MPL-2.0 转为 Apache-2.0，自 2.0 起提供 AgentOS——基于 FastAPI 的运行时，含控制面 UI、JWT RBAC、human-in-the-loop 与审计日志。
